svg.title: Fig. 92 — y = sin x / x between the hyperbolas xy = ±1
svg.desc: Redrawn from Robert C. Yates, A Handbook on Curves and Their Properties (1947), Fig. 92, page 101. Section: discontinuous.

g.data-text: The axes and the four branches of the bounding hyperbolas xy = 1 and xy = −1; |sin x| ≤ 1 gives |sin x / x| ≤ 1/|x|.
The curve y = sin x / x for −3π ≤ x ≤ 3π: it touches the hyperbolas where |sin x| = 1, crosses the x-axis at ±π, ±2π, ±3π, and has its maximum 1 at x = 0, where the point is open.
